about.title: A Baytown shop that answers its own phone.
text: Bayline started as one technician and one van serving neighbors in Baytown. The company grew one customer referral at a time, and it still runs the same way: the person who answers the phone is in the office down the hall from the technicians.
Today the crew covers heating, cooling and electrical, so a new air conditioner and the circuit it needs can be handled by one team on one schedule.

faqs.q: How often should my air conditioner be serviced?
faqs.a: Once a year, in spring, before it runs every day. Systems that also heat get a second visit in the fall.

faqs.q: Do you charge a trip fee?
faqs.a: There is a diagnostic fee to find the problem, and it is credited toward the repair if you go ahead with it.

faqs.q: Should I repair or replace an old system?
faqs.a: If the system is past 12 to 15 years and the repair is a large one, replacement usually costs less over time. The technician gives you both prices so you can decide.

faqs.q: Can you add a circuit for a new AC or EV charger?
faqs.a: Yes. Our electricians check your panel's capacity first and pull the permit where one is required.
Yes, on new systems and panel upgrades. Ask for the options when you book the estimate.
